body.text:
The first thing I look at every morning isn’t my inbox anymore. It’s a custom CEO briefing dashboard that gives me the exact health of our business, and I built it without writing a single line of code.

It pulls live data straight from our codebase, database, and APIs so I can see our daily active users, how many people are using Ella, and how many autoposts went through. 

I built the entire thing using @claudeai Code 💻 It runs directly in the terminal, so I just used plan mode to explain exactly what I wanted in plain, non-technical English. It gave me a plan, I approved the steps, and it built the dashboard in minutes.

As a founder, getting this kind of real-time visibility usually takes weeks of engineering time. Being able to spin up exactly what I need, when I need it, completely changes how fast we can move. 

There is so much more I want to build with this now. What do you think I should try building next? #ClaudePartner
